ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says 'Fill your bellies with it'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the physical and spiritual gluttony of the disbelievers, who fill their bellies with unlawful or excessive sustenance, reflecting their inner emptiness and disregard for divine guidance. This consumption is not merely dietary but symbolizes their absorption of worldly desires at the expense of spiritual nourishment, a theme often linked to the concept of *batil* (falsehood) consuming the truth.
